news.headline: Open Point Acquires Converlens to Expand Engagement Intelligence Capabilities
Open Point Launches Unified Platform for Integrated Community and Stakeholder Engagement
Welcoming Leanne Robb: Bringing 25+ Years of Expertise to Social Pinpoint

paragraphs: Open Point sells one platform that combines community engagement with stakeholder relationship management. The company states that the platform brings community voices and stakeholder relationships into one place across the project lifecycle. Stakeholder records centralize contact details, project context, relationships, and engagement history in one connected profile.

The platform is sold as two products, Community Engagement and Stakeholder Relationship Management. Social Point by Open Point brings participation tools, visual project pages, and built-in reporting together for running engagement. Engagement tools listed include interactive maps, budget simulations, surveys, polls, and idea boards.

The reporting product processes consultation responses, submissions, emails, transcripts and stakeholder communications. Open Point states that the reporting product is designed for government, infrastructure, utilities, energy and planning organizations. An industries section on the homepage lists Local & State Government among the markets named.

quote.text: Open Point brings all community voices and stakeholder relationships into one place, so you can understand perspectives, build trust, and drive delivery across the full project lifecycle.
